place.title: Place {ref} (tilt switch)
place.text: Push the tilt switch {ref}'s 2 legs into column f: one into hole {hole.a}, the other into {hole.b}. Stand it straight up.
place.tip: The legs have no + or −: either way round works. Upright, the ball inside touches both legs.

why: {ref} is a tilt switch: a small metal ball inside joins its two legs while it stands upright and rolls away when it is tilted, so the Pico can tell whether it is upright.

wire.ground: This connects {ref}'s other leg to ground: while the ball touches both legs, the pin reads 0.
wire.in: {pin} reads {ref}: 0 while it stands upright (the ball connects the pin to ground) and 1 while it is tilted (the Pico's internal pull-up).
